Ser118 lies on the helix spanning ~114–128. Its side chain (CB at ‑6.28, ‑2.41, 2.77; OG at ‑7.05, ‑2.69, 1.62) is wedged between several hydrophobic/packing partners:

- Phe30 ring atoms (CD2 4.3 Å, CE2 4.0 Å, CZ 4.9 Å from CB)
- Ile31 CB/CG1/CG2 (4.1–4.6 Å)
- Arg34 CD (3.3 Å) and NE (3.9 Å) from OG
- Tyr115 CB/CG (~6 Å), Ala117 CB (5.4 Å), Lys119 CG/CD (~5.3 Å), Leu122 CG/CD1 (5.2–5.7 Å)

The small Ser side chain is therefore enclosed on all sides by the neighboring helix (25–37) packing against its own helix, leaving essentially no exposed surface; only limited backbone area remains accessible, giving a low relative SASA.

FINAL: buried
